{{Quote|Well done, pilot! Amazing work. You completely destroyed the Dual Moons.|[[Dartas Pytin]], to a pilot|<ref name="SWG:AtT" />}}
The '''Dual Moons''' were a pair of similar [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:AtT" /> They resembled those used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] or [[Miner/Legends|miners]].<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref> The Dual Moons were located in the [[Scarlet Dawn]] quadrant, the heart of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] operations in the Bright Jewel system. Along with the [[Darkveil Eclipse]], they formed the [[Salient Trinity]], the three Black Sun [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] bases in the system.<ref name="SWG:AtT" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Dual Moons starfighters were led by [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commanders]] [[Chaen]] and [[Ondara]]. During the [[Battle of Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Battle of Tansarii Point Station]], the Dual Moons served as the first line of defense for the Darkveil Eclipse and were attacked by [[Dartas Pytin]]'s [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]] starfighters. Most of the Black Sun forces were eliminated, including Chaen and Ondara.<ref name="SWG:AtT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dual Moons appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
